Fractal Appoints Leandro DalleMule as Chief Practice Officer

Fractal, a company, has announced the appointment of Leandro DalleMule to the position of Chief Practice Officer. In this new role, DalleMule will be responsible for the financial services and insurance sectors. The appointment was reported by multiple news outlets.
